title: Post-Training Policy Replication for Strategy-Following Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning across Team Sizes
abstract: arXiv:2611.34035v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although multi-agent deep reinforcement learning enables coordinated behavior, aligning it with managerial intent remains difficult due to complex agent interactions. Although the strategy-following distributed attentional actor architecture (sfDA7-X) improves controllability via regional instructions, instruction combinations scale exponentially with team and instruction sizes, leading to prohibitive training costs and poor transferability. To reduce this computational cost, we introduce a team-size-independent observation architecture and reconstruct collective behavior by replicating a single trained policy across agents in teams of different sizes, thereby eliminating the need to train from scratch. Additionally, we evaluate warm-start retraining by initializing policy networks with a pre-trained policy to significantly lower computational overhead. translated_title: 面向跨团队规模的策略遵循型多智能体深度强化学习的训练后策略复制方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34035v1 公告类型： cross 摘要： 尽管多智能体深度强化学习能够实现协调行为，但由于智能体间复杂的交互作用，使其与管理意图保持一致仍然十分困难。虽然策略遵循分布式注意力行动者架构通过区域指令提升了可控性，但指令组合的数量会随团队规模和指令规模呈指数级增长，导致训练成本过高且可迁移性差。为降低这一计算成本，我们引入了一种与团队规模无关的观测架构，并通过将单个已训练策略复制到不同规模团队中的各个智能体上来重构集体行为，从而免除了从头训练的需要。此外，我们通过使用预训练策略对策略网络进行初始化来评估热启动再训练，以显著降低计算开销。在一个物体收集游戏中，在四智能体团队中训练的策略被部署到……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种与团队规模无关的观测架构，通过将单个预训练策略复制到不同规模团队的各智能体并辅以热启动再训练，显著降低了策略遵循型多智能体强化学习的训练成本并提升了跨团队规模的可迁移性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a team-size-independent observation architecture that replicates a single pre-trained policy across agents in teams of different sizes, together with warm-start retraining, significantly reducing training costs and improving transferability in strategy-following multi-agent deep reinforcement learning.
